gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-amiko: Stretched and stark, Nulshock runs wide with generous tracking and an unshaded outline, while Amiko sets tall lowercase with terminals flaring outward. Paragraphs in Amiko move along briskly and without fuss.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-devanagari: Technical and stretched, Nulshock holds one unshaded outline across its widely spaced letters. And Anek Devanagari, with open mouths and a tall middle zone, makes longer text feel easy-going.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-gujarati: Nulshock stretches wide with generous tracking, its curves carrying the same heft as a rope throughout. Anek Gujarati brings a lowercase that rivals its capitals and a gaping c opening, which is the real standout.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Wide, steady, technical: Nulshock skims along on a stroke weight that never changes, tracked out generously. And Anek Gurmukhi, with big open counters, gives that stretched heading a sans-serif partner with open-handed curves.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-kannada: Nulshock stretches out with spacious tracking and an unshaded outline with no thick-thin pulse. But Nulshock is built to announce, while Anek Kannada, with far-stopping terminals and a high x-height, is built for running text.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-latin: Spacious and technical, Nulshock holds a steady unshaded outline with no swelling mid-curve anywhere. Anek Latin lifts its lowercase nearly to capital height, so longer text feels held open rather than curled shut.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps its lowercase close to cap height, with curve tips that never quite touch. And across many lines it moves with unclosed curves, a loose counterpoint to Nulshock's stretched outlines.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia reads with rounds left unsealed, like an unlatched hook, and a lowercase sitting just under its capitals. And Nulshock, drawn as if with a fixed pen, stretches out its spacing to make a technical counterpart.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big round lowercase bowls, their curves looking half unwrapped. Anek Tamil is the plain sans for reading, while Nulshock, a monoline stroke from start to finish, is the one for announcing.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-telugu: Nulshock stretches wide and technical, with no brush-style pressure swell anywhere in its unshaded outline. Anek Telugu handles the reading, its wide, tall bowls and unsealed rounds setting the rhythm, while Nulshock simply announces.
